findings.routing_source_scope: Default source keeps original model expert routing; documentation describes original eight experts. Lookahead predictions alter prefetch/scheduling, not required routed-expert computation. Exact downloaded metadata not inspected.
documented_limits: Earlier third consecutive request had no completion record and DSP queue errors; six fresh-process samples do not establish continuous reliability.

related_current_runtime_checks.name: TokForge Qwen3.5-4B W4 / QAIRT 2.51 prompt pack
related_current_runtime_checks.resident_number_scope: Publisher says NPU memory is additional to the separately paired MNN model; it is not whole-process RSS or just the downloaded pack size.
related_current_runtime_checks.execution_split: NPU prompt processing; CPU reply decoding with the exactly paired MNN model.
related_current_runtime_checks.assessment: Additional primary evidence that hybrid NPU-prefill/CPU-decode is implemented on v79. This is a separate runtime and weight-pairing route, not a drop-in model or measured Hepta improvement.

related_current_runtime_checks.name: Qualcomm Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct full QAIRT bundle availability
related_current_runtime_checks.assessment: The inspected official card lists complete pre-exported GENIEX_QAIRT bundles for X2 Elite, X Elite and Dragonwing targets, but no complete SM8750 bundle. Its SM8750 table entries are Vision-Encoder rows without full decoder measurements. The broad chipset list on the hub landing page is insufficient proof of a ready whole-model phone package.

related_current_runtime_checks.name: LFM3-VL-2B / LFM3-1.7B latest dense edge models
related_current_runtime_checks.vl_architecture: Dense tri-hybrid: gated short convolutions, sliding-window attention and global attention.
related_current_runtime_checks.geniex_route: Preview community GGUF / llama.cpp, not the hardware-compiled QAIRT Qwen bundle route.
related_current_runtime_checks.publisher_limit: The VLM model card does not recommend multi-turn conversations or complex reasoning. Text LFM3-1.7B targets local agents but is not recommended for complex multi-step reasoning.
related_current_runtime_checks.assessment: A current smaller visual-expert candidate worth a separate comparison. No change to the validated Qwen3-VL-4B R3 path, and no claim that the current fixed SDK supports its full graph or meets the phone-control contracts.

accelerator_guidance.retrieval_scope: Official search-index excerpt; full documentation page required JavaScript and had no readable lines.
accelerator_guidance.prefill: Parallel input phase uses HMX/HVX compute.
accelerator_guidance.decode: Autoregressive batch-one decode is commonly DDR weight/KV bandwidth limited.

generation_boundary.publisher_claim: Next-generation Hexagon adds an Element Accelerator and 50% larger shared memory; a 30B MoE example activates approximately 3B routed parameters and uses flash-to-memory expert management. The September 22 StepEdge-Omni deployment announcement explicitly names Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6.
generation_boundary.assessment: These announcements support a newer-platform research direction; they do not establish INT2 hardware execution, whole-model deployment or those performance gains on this razr. No Gen 6 result is counted as a v79 test.
